text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Civic Appointments Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Elected Councillor Cynthia Lai as Vice Chair of the Civic Appointments Committee for a term of office starting January 10, 2019 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
